title: Exercise Linear fixture adapter
description:
## Issue Setup

- UAT Required: No

## Issue Goal

Exercise the Linear tracker adapter through fixture-backed dry-run planning.

## Why Now

Jade Symphony needs a credential-free Linear path that proves the normalized tracker boundary.

## Issue Context

The live Linear adapter uses GraphQL behind the tracker trait, while local dogfood can run with fixture issues.

## Decisions / Assumptions

### Decisions

- Keep Linear fields normalized before they reach the orchestrator.

### Assumptions

- Fixture-backed planning is enough when Linear credentials are unavailable.

## Non-Negotiable Guardrails

- Do not add Linear-specific paths to the orchestrator.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Fixture-backed Linear planning.
- Normalized issue fields.

### Out of Scope

- Live Linear mutation.

## Canonical References

### Target Repository / Package

- Alive24/jade-symphony

### Relevant Knowledge Sources

- docs/bootstrap/references/openai-symphony/SPEC.md
- docs/bootstrap/references/openai-symphony/elixir/lib/symphony_elixir/linear/client.ex
- docs/bootstrap/references/openai-symphony/elixir/lib/symphony_elixir/linear/adapter.ex

### Relevant Code Paths

- src/tracker.rs
- src/config.rs
- src/model.rs

## Current State

Linear fixture adapter path exists.

## Deliverable Shape

Fixture and workflow smoke path.

## Risks or Constraints

- Must not imply live Linear credentials are configured.

## Expected Outcome

Linear fixture issues can be planned through the same orchestrator.

## Verification

### Completion Criteria

- cargo run -- plan examples/linear-fixture-workflow.md shows this issue as runnable.

### Functional Verification

- cargo test

### UAT

- Not required.

### Context Verification

- Confirm the orchestrator only sees TrackerIssue.
